fields.Name: International Cheese Federation Blog and Updates - October 2019
fields.Description: This page from the International Cheese Federation website showcases recent news and updates, specifically highlighting two articles from October 2019. Topics include webinars on judging standards and rennet alternatives, and a member spotlight on a farmstead owner's advocacy efforts. The page also provides general information about the federation, its archives, categories, and membership opportunities.

Yuri Lee 




 


The member who answers every comment period 

 

A small farmstead owner rarely makes it to a conference, but has signed nearly every advocacy petition the federation has circulated this decade — and wants more members doing the same.
